verdict.rationale: bizfile California is an online portal for filing, searching, and ordering business records. A portal like this could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any built-in AI assistant, chatbot, or task-delegation feature; the documented features are manual filings, searches, certificate orders, and User Access controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
